spans.s:
mn. (-हः-हं)
The body.
E.
दिह to collect together, affix घञ्.

m. (-षः)
1 The skin.
2 A feather, a wing.
E.
देह body, and कोष a sheath or covering.

m. (-यः)
Disease, sickness.
E.
देह the body, and क्षय a wasting.

mfn. (-तः-ता-तं)
Separated or detached from the body, (as excrement or the spirit, &c.)
E.
देह, and च्युत fallen.

m. (-गः)
1 Voluntary death.
2 Death in general.
E.
देह, and त्याग leaving.

m. (-दः)
Quicksilver.
E.
देह, and द what gives.

n. (-कं)
A bone.
E.
देह the body, and धारक sustainer.

m. (-धिः)
A wing.
E.
देह the body, धा to have, and कि aff.

m. (-धृक्)
Air, wind.
E.
देह the body, धृज् to pervade, क्विप् aff.

mfn. (-भृत्)
1 Living, being.
2 Embodied, corporeal.
m. (-त्)
Life, vitality.
E.
देह the body, भृत् what has or supports.

f. (-त्रा)
1 Death, dying.
2 Food.
E.
देह the body, यात्रा proceeding, (to or by which.)

f. (-ला)
Spirituous liquor.
E.
देह the body, ला to seize, affix उ, and टाप्.

f. (-लिः or ली)
1 The threshold of a door, the lower part of the wooden frame of a door, or a raised terrace in front of it.
E.
देह here said to imply plastering of cow-dung, &c. ला to have or get, affix कि or क, and ङीष्.

m. (-रः)
Marrow.
E.
देह, and सार essence.

mfn. (वान्-वती-वत्)
Corporeal, inhabiting a body.
E.
देह, and मतुप् aff.

m. (-दी)
A Cārvāka, a materialist.
E.
देह, and आत्मन् the soul, and वादिन् who maintains; asserting that the body and soul are one.

Armour.
2

Dress.
E.
देह, and आवरण screening.

f. (-ला)
A sort of insect, (a flea.)
E.
देह the body, affix ठन्, and टाप्.

mfn. (-ही-हिनी-हि)
1 Corporeal, embodied, having body.
2 Living, a living being.
m. (-ही)
The spirit.
E.
देह, and हनि aff.
